logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

A clean horizontal bar chart for the WO-01 assurance handover, single column, white background, sans-serif labels. Four bars on a common kWh axis: P2 = 12 kWh (dark green, labeled "verified winner"), P3 = 52 kWh (blue), P1 = 56 kWh (gray-blue), P4 = 58 kWh (tan). Dashed vertical line at 52 kWh labeled "policy fallback: P3". Below the chart, a four-box decision workflow: Trusted source table -> Gate check (all four qualify) -> Rank energies 12/52/56/58 -> Award P2, fallback P3. A short annotation flags the round-1 correction: A named P4 as fallback, but the policy gives P3 (52 kWh), and B's audit missed it. Footer strip lists carried-forward open items: P2's single defect uncharacterized, single fixed-duty acceptance run, P3 exactly at the quality threshold, cost/delivery/maintenance/reliability unverified. No decorative imagery; every element serves the client's verification record.
